Clean Up Georgia Phase III (Hazard Waste) GNSE Orchis

description.narrative: Georgia Society of Nature Explorers "Orchis" har ansökt om stöd på 15 MSEK för att genomföra projektet Clean Up Georgia Phase III (Hazard Waste) under perioden 2015-2018. Insatsens syftar till att förbättra miljön och begränsa klimatförändringar genom att förbättra avfallshantering och öka miljömässig ansvarstagande hos allmänheten. Insatsens totala budget ä 15 MSEK. 67 % av det totala beloppet, kommer att vidareförmedlas från GNSE Orchis till samarbetspartnern Greens Movement of Georgia/ Friends of Earth of Georgia, Ecological Awareness and Waste Management.

Georgia Society of Nature Explorers "Orchis" has applied to Sida for funding of 15 million SEK to carry out the the project "Clean Up Georgia Phase III (Hazard Waste)"" in Georgia during the period 2015-2018. The intervention aims to improve environment and reduce climate change impact through challenging of waste management and enhancing population responsibility in Georgia with the specific objectives:
1) Enhance environmental responsibility of population on national and local level in Georgia (60 Self governing communities and 12 Self Governing Cities) to reduce pollution by solid waste through organising clean up campaigns, World Clean Up events. 2) Challenge waste management practise and system on national and local level in the country and mainstream environment to increase compliance with Georgia EU Association Agreement requirements on the environmental protection. 3) Enhance environmental responsibility of population, business sector and civil society to reduce pollution by hazardous waste in the country.
The intervention’s total budget is 15 million SEK out of which 67 % of the intervention budget will be forwarded from GSNE Orchis to partner organisations Greens Movement of Georgia/ Friends of Earth of Georgia, Ecological Awareness and Waste Management.
